svg.title: Layout F: Strength-first dark header. Fictional product, not for medical use.
svg.desc: Three separated units. A dark header shows 250 mg in large white type with ZORVEX beside it. Examplecetam is below the header, then the cavity, then EXP 08/2028 and BATCH ZX1042. Red dotted lines mark the proposed separation boundaries. Early concept visualization, not measured to a real strip.
svg.text: red dotted line = proposed separation boundary
